summary:
Iteration 127 — formal regression after ci_demo.py backend extraction + verification of Demo Everywhere, global DEMO ribbon, and Recap Auto-Send. Backend pytest 19/19 PASS (test_iter127_ci_demo_regression.py). Frontend Playwright end-to-end PASS across the full unified-demo user story. Environment left clean (demo cleared, recap toggle left ON per instructions).

Backend (19/19): ci_demo.py routes register correctly on ci_router — GET /control-intelligence/demo/state (false→true→false), POST /auditor-link/demo/seed returns {seeded:true, events:6, links:2, reviewers:2}, GET /auditor-link/demo/status counters ≥6/2/1, POST /auditor-link/demo/clear returns cleared:true. Live-side effects verified: GET /auditor-link/access shows Priya/Elena/Marcus rows tagged demo:true; GET /auditor-link/analytics totals reflect views≥4/downloads≥2/reviewers≥2; GET /controls?demo=true returns ≥2 demo_at_risk with the first at effectiveness=47 status=Failing (matches IAM-3 lead per _apply_demo_at_risk); recap/preview HTML references 'Dana Ops' (nudged_owners staged by seed). Regression on the rest of the CI suite passes: settings GET+PUT persists recap_enabled:true + recap_weekday:0 (Monday); effectiveness-history 200; auditor-link/activity returns views/downloads/reviewers; recap/history returns {history:[...]}; timeline returns {people:[...]}; timeline.pdf returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF header; POST /auditor-link generates a token, public /public/auditor-link/{token}/meta resolves 200, revoke 200; owner-nudges/preview 200.

Frontend end-to-end: login via /login using Enter-key submit on password field (auth-submit click intercepted by decorative overlay at 1920x1080 — same as prior iterations). Pre-clear API returned 200. Defensibility tab shows ci-demo-journey-panel + ci-demo-journey-seed. Clicking seed → within ~2s the amber ci-demo-journey-active banner appears, button flips to ci-demo-journey-clear, and the global data-testid=demo-mode-ribbon becomes visible in the app shell (window 'ci-demo-changed' event fires — no page reload needed). Access log lit up with 6 demo badges (ci-auditor-access-demo-0…5). Reviewer engagement analytics rendered with awaiting-download indicator (ci-analytics-awaiting present). Reviewer timeline panel rendered. Recap history button opened list. Recap Auto-Send: ci-recap-weekday value is '0' (Monday); toggle present. Navigated to /app (Executive Overview) — DEMO ribbon persists (visible on Exec Overview) and exec-assurance-activity badge renders (live from /auditor-link/activity). Back on CI: Mission Control ci-kpi-atrisk reads '1' during demo. Remediation & Drift tab: ci-nudge-preview AUTO-LOADED without click (admin + demo=true branch, screenshot confirms 'Owner reminder preview · demo data' with 2 at-risk controls / 2 owners → Dana Ops + Sam Vuln). Clicking ci-demo-journey-clear: banner disappears, DEMO ribbon disappears app-wide within ~2s, seed button returns. Mission Control ci-kpi-atrisk resets to '0'. All 6 CI tabs (Mission Control, Control Effectiveness, Framework Intelligence, Evidence Assurance, Remediation & Drift, Defensibility) load without errors. Final API clear returned 200 — environment cleaned; recap toggle intentionally left ON per instructions.

issues: Clicking data-testid=auth-submit continues to be intercepted by a decorative overlay at 1920x1080 — Enter-key submit works reliably. Non-blocking, carried from iter126.

critical_code_review_comments: Clean extraction: ci_demo.py imports ci_router from control_intelligence and attaches only the demo endpoints — good separation and no import cycle. server.py registers via `import ci_demo` (side-effect route registration) — works but a linter could flag; the `# noqa: F401` comment is appropriate.
auditor_demo_seed is idempotent (delete_many demo:true rows before insert). Marker upsert is scoped to demo:true — clear correctly removes only demo markers. Nice.
demo/state combines org.ci_demo_active with a fallback count on ci_auditor_access — resilient if the org flag is somehow missing but demo rows exist.
control_intelligence.py is still ~1182 lines even after the extraction — Recap/Timeline/Brief/Analytics/AuditorLink/Nudge submodules would each be natural next splits (repeated from iter126).

GET /auditor-link/recap/history returns {history:[…]} but many list-style CI endpoints return bare arrays — inconsistent envelope. Consider standardising to {items:[…]} or bare arrays across the router.

_apply_demo_at_risk mutates the first 2 Passing controls into Failing(47)+Drifting(61); no guarantee those are IAM-3 / VM-2 by ref. Behaviour matches the seed narrative today because IAM-3/VM-2 happen to be the first Passing rows — worth pinning by ref for stability.

seed_data_creation: Demo journey seeded then cleared in-test (idempotent). One auditor-link minted then revoked. recap_settings temporarily set to {recap_enabled:true, recap_weekday:0} — LEFT ENABLED per main-agent cleanup instructions ('do NOT disable the recap toggle'). Final demo clear returned 200; no residual demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes after the ci_demo.py extraction: demo endpoints live in /app/backend/ci_demo.py but still under prefix /api/control-intelligence (they attach to the imported ci_router). Correct paths: POST /auditor-link/demo/seed, POST /auditor-link/demo/clear, GET /auditor-link/demo/status, GET /demo/state. Other CI routes: POST /auditor-link (generate), POST /auditor-link/revoke, GET /auditor-link/access (returns {events:[…]}), GET /auditor-link/analytics ({links,reviewers,totals}), GET /auditor-link/activity (flat), GET /auditor-link/recap/history ({history:[…]}), GET /auditor-link/recap/preview (HTML), GET /auditor-link/timeline ({people:[…]}), GET /auditor-link/timeline.pdf, GET /owner-nudges/preview, GET /public/auditor-link/{token}/meta. /api/controls (routes.py, not ci_router) supports ?demo=true and returns an array with demo_at_risk overlay. Global DEMO ribbon reacts to the window 'ci-demo-changed' event dispatched by DefensibilityDashboard seed/clear handlers plus a 45s poll of /demo/state — persists app-wide via <DemoRibbon/> rendered in AppShell right after </header>. Login continues to require Enter-key submit.
